Problem: A new program had 60 downloads in the first month. The number of downloads in the second month was three times as many as the downloads in the first month, but then reduced by 30% in the third month. How many downloads did the program have total over
Solution: The number of downloads of the program in the second month increased to 3*60 = <<3*60=180>>180
In the first two months, the total number of downloads of the program was 180+60 = <<180+60=240>>240
